name: Golden A/S Service
subtitle: Field service for Golden staff
promotionalText: The field tool of Golden A/S service engineers — reports, tickets, equipment and hours, on board and offline.
description:
Golden A/S Service is the field application for the service engineers of Golden Automation Systems (Golden A/S), the marine electrical, automation and navigation systems integrator based in Keratsini, Greece, with branches in Italy and the Netherlands.

An account issued by Golden A/S is required. The app is a companion to the Golden A/S portal and is not intended for the general public.

With it an engineer on board or at a shipyard can:
• see the tickets and work orders assigned to them and the day's schedule
• write field service and inspection reports with tasks, time lines, parts and photos taken with the camera, and submit them for approval
• browse the equipment of the vessel by system or location, with its service history
• book working hours per project and section, with overtime, holiday and travel
• reach HR for leave requests and messages
• keep working without a connection — drafts are kept on the device and synchronised later
• In / Out: clock in and clock out with the time and the position at that moment

Sign-in with password and authenticator code, or with Face ID / Touch ID and passkeys after the first sign-in. All data stays on the Golden A/S portal; nothing is shared with third parties.
whatsNew: Sign in with Face ID: you can now add this phone as a passkey in the app (More, Passkeys, Add this device) and sign in without password and authenticator code. Notifications about sales are no longer shown in this app. Corrections and improvements.
reviewNotes:
1. SCREEN RECORDING
Attached in the Attachment field of this App Review Information section (GoldenService_review_recording.mp4). Recorded on a physical iPhone with the demo account; it shows: launch from the home screen, sign-in with e-mail and password, Home with the assignments of the day, an assignment accepted with its sub-project, the ticket opened, a field service report started from the ticket with equipment, a photo taken with the camera, working time, the customer's signature on the phone and submission, the Reports list, Hours (day booked, week view), Tickets, More, My HR (leave balances and a leave request form), Lock app and unlock with Face ID, and sign-out.

2. PURPOSE AND AUDIENCE
Golden A/S Service is the internal field-service app of Golden A/S (Golden Automation Systems), a marine electrical, automation and navigation systems integrator based in Piraeus, Greece. It is used only by the company's own service engineers on board vessels and in shipyards. It lets them see the tickets and work orders assigned to them, write field service and inspection reports with tasks, time, parts and photos taken with the camera, browse the equipment of a vessel with its service history, book working hours and send leave requests. It works offline and synchronises later. It is not intended for the general public.

3. ACCESS
Sign in with the demo account given in the App Review Information section (service-engineer role, no authenticator code needed). This account is a demonstration account: the app shows a built-in demonstration data set (invented tickets, vessels and people) and no company data. Tabs: Home, Tickets, Reports, Hours, More. The camera is used only to attach photos to a report. In / Out (More › In / Out) registers the start and end of work: the notice is accepted once, then when the button is pressed the app asks for the location (When In Use), takes one position and sends it with the time to the company server; there is no background location and no tracking. With the demonstration account the entries are invented and what is registered is not kept in the company records. The link "Open in Google Maps" on an entry opens Google Maps with the stored coordinates. The app has no account registration: accounts are created by the company administrator in the company portal, so there is no in-app account creation or deletion. An employee's account is closed by the administrator when employment ends.

4. EXTERNAL SERVICES
The app talks only to Golden A/S's own server (https://www.goldensas.com) over HTTPS. No third-party analytics, advertising or payment service is used. Sign-in uses the company's own accounts, with optional authenticator (TOTP) and passkeys; Face ID / Touch ID is used on the device only. The app registers with Apple Push Notification service for notifications; no other notification service is used. An optional writing assistant, switched off unless the company administrator enables it for an account, sends the text of the form the user is editing through the company server to the Anthropic Claude API to propose wording; the user decides whether to use the proposal.

5. REGIONS
The app works the same in all regions. Languages: English, Greek, Italian, Ukrainian, Bulgarian.

6. REGULATED CONTENT
None. The app contains no third-party protected material, no purchases and no paid content. Project data belongs to Golden A/S and its customers and is processed under the privacy policy: https://www.goldenas.com.gr/privacy.html

USER CONTENT
Notes and comments are exchanged only between signed-in employees of the company; there is no public content.

DISTRIBUTION
The app is for the company's own staff. We will request unlisted distribution for it once approved, so that it is not discoverable on the App Store. New: push notifications (permission asked after sign-in; sent by our server; the app works without it).
